test_cases.title: Find a product whose name contains the submitted keyword
test_cases.preconditions: The catalog contains a product named Travel Mug and the search page is open.
test_cases.expected: Products with names containing the submitted keyword are shown, including Travel Mug.

test_cases.title: Match product names without regard to keyword case
test_cases.preconditions: The catalog contains a product named Travel Mug and the search page is open.
steps: Search for mug and record the displayed results.
Search for MUG and record the displayed results.
test_cases.expected: The same products are returned for the lowercase and uppercase keywords, consistent with case-insensitive matching.

test_cases.title: Show the specified message when no product matches
test_cases.preconditions: The catalog contains no product whose name contains the chosen test keyword and the search page is open.
steps: Submit a non-empty keyword that is absent from every product name.
test_cases.expected: The page displays: No products found.

priority_rationales.rationale: High: failure to return matching products undermines the primary search purpose; likelihood is unassessed.
High: case-sensitive behavior would violate an explicit matching criterion; likelihood is unassessed.
Medium: a clear no-results response is an explicit criterion, though it is a less common path; likelihood is unmeasured.

open_questions: Does 'name contains keyword' mean literal substring matching or whole-token matching?
How should an empty or whitespace-only query behave?
Are leading/trailing spaces trimmed, and how are punctuation or accents handled?
Are search results ordered, paginated, or filterable?

coverage_notes.criterion: AC1: Submitting a non-empty keyword shows products whose names contain that keyword.
gaps: Clarify whether contains means literal substring or whole token.

coverage_notes.criterion: AC3: When no product matches, the page displays 'No products found.'
